name: Venrose Supplier FX Pricing
author: venrose

sections.description:
Venrose Supplier FX Pricing helps WooCommerce store owners calculate product prices from supplier prices in another currency.

Features:

  • Store a supplier currency and supplier list price on a simple product.
  • Calculate a supplier sale price using a percentage discount or a manually entered supplier sale price.
  • Enter the exchange rate manually.
  • Preview the calculated WooCommerce regular and sale prices before applying them.
  • Update WooCommerce prices from the product editor.

This free version supports simple products. It does not request exchange rates from external services and does not include variable-product pricing, bulk updates, or scheduled updates.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the venrose-supplier-fx-pricing folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Activate Venrose Supplier FX Pricing.
  4. Edit a simple WooCommerce product and open the Venrose FX Pricing tab.
  5. Enter the supplier currency, supplier list price, discount method, and exchange rate.
  6. Click Update WooCommerce Prices to calculate and apply the WooCommerce regular and sale prices.

Enter an exchange rate that converts the supplier currency into your WooCommerce store currency. If both currencies are the same, enter 1.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin fetch exchange rates automatically?

No. This version uses the exchange rate you enter for each product. It does not send requests to an exchange-rate API.

Does it support variable products?

No. This free version supports simple products only.

Does it change WooCommerce prices automatically when I edit the supplier fields?

Use the Update WooCommerce Prices button in the Venrose FX Pricing tab to calculate and apply the prices. Saving the product normally saves the supplier fields but does not itself run the price calculation.
